text.en: Clients consistently highlight groomers Jen and Alicia for their dedicated attention and friendly communication. Several pet owners note that the staff take time to understand specific styling requests and show genuine dedication towards long-term clients. Reviewers express strong trust in the team, frequently noting that groomers build positive rapport with nervous animals.

Pet owners frequently praise the quality of haircuts, scissor styling, and bathing treatments provided at the salon. Reviewers describe standard poodles, doodles, and rescue dogs leaving with neat coats that smell fresh and look well maintained. Multiple clients note that coats remain soft and tidy for weeks following their scheduled grooming sessions.

Reviewers appreciate the cage-free salon environment, noting that it reduces stress for animals with separation anxiety or reactivity. Dog owners mention that their pets appear relaxed and cheerful at collection rather than anxious. Clients with rescue dogs that require careful handling praise the calm, reassuring approach used throughout grooming.

q.en: Does Oasis Pet Grooming offer cage-free appointments?

a.en: Yes, pet owners confirm that the salon operates a cage-free setting designed to help keep dogs calm and comfortable.

q.en: Can owners schedule grooming for rescue dogs with anxiety?

a.en: Yes, clients report that groomers handle nervous and rescue dogs with patience, helping them feel settled during appointments.

q.en: Are both dogs and cats groomed at this salon?

a.en: Yes, the business website specifies that bath and haircut services are available for both canine and feline pets.

q.en: Can clients book grooming sessions online?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides an online booking system for scheduling bath and styling appointments in advance.
